I hope you are doing well.

Regarding your extension request, we have shared the rates for the upcoming period as below:

Current extension: AED 18,453.71 for 93 nights, as previously quoted.
November: AED 8,500 for 30 nights
December: AED 13,700 for 30 nights
January: AED 13,700 for 30 nights
Please note that each month will be calculated as a 30-night stay.

We are currently awaiting your payment confirmation to proceed with securing the extension. Kindly update us once the payment has been completed or let us know if you require any further assistance.

Thank you, and we look forward to your confirmation.

Kind regards,
